description: Land Title Settlement Department    - Dehigolla, Mahiyanganaya D/S Division,  Badulla   District - Cad. Map No. 710024
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring the determination of title for specific land parcels (Nos. 209 and 210) in Dehigolla village.
